body:
## Goal

Review the report-only Phase 2 listing-freshness hardening on the merged Phase 1 security foundation and verify it for the user-authorized merge.

## Current outcome

- PR #86 is reviewed at head `5396497` against `main` at `f640a16`.
- The final blocker-fix commit is `c97e799`.
- GitHub reports the pull request clean and mergeable, and required CI passed.
- An independent final code/security review passed with no remaining high- or medium-severity findings.
- The user authorized merging PR #86 on 2026-09-04; deployment, publication, notification, and automatic listing edits remain unauthorized.

## Hardened behavior

- Candidate dates must be associated with the target event instead of unrelated page-wide dates.
- Date parsing accepts only strict, valid four-digit-year dates and ranges of at most 31 days.
- A fresh single-run manifest binds the profile, source inputs, CSV digest, timestamps, and live/dry state.
- Stale, future, altered, mixed-run, mixed live/dry, wrong-profile, and incomplete evidence fails closed.
- Automatic HTTP retries are disabled; operation timeouts and a 20-second total request deadline are enforced.
- Plaintext HTTP evidence cannot produce an exact proposal or pass readiness.
- External CSV and Markdown values are escaped before review artifacts are written.
- Readiness requires fresh live same-day evidence, secure transport, all manual expectations matching, no unresolved facts, and zero automatic actions.

title: Supervisor health dashboard stale: 9d19h (#2)
body:
## Premise

The dashboard at #2 last refreshed `2026-10-16T13:10:37Z` — **9d19h ago** (threshold: 2d0h). The `stats-wrapper.sh` scheduler is likely failing silently.

## Why this matters

The supervisor health dashboard is the framework's primary single-glance health surface. When it stops refreshing, operators keep trusting green numbers that no longer reflect reality — every decision derived from "dashboard says green" becomes invalid.

## Triage

1. Inspect the stats scheduler status.

   macOS / launchd:

   ```bash
   launchctl list | grep -i aidevops-stats-wrapper
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist
   ```

   Linux / systemd user timers:

   ```bash
   systemctl --user status aidevops-stats-wrapper.timer --no-pager
   systemctl --user status aidevops-stats-wrapper.service --no-pager
   systemctl --user list-timers --all --no-pager 'aidevops*'
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/.config/systemd/user/aidevops-stats-wrapper.*
   ```

2. Run the refresh manually and capture the error:

   ```bash
   bash ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh 2>&1 | tail -40
   ```

3. Check the dashboard issue directly:

   ```bash
   gh api repos/nezumitora/coin-shows-near-me/issues/2 --jq '{updated_at, body_length: (.body|length)}'
   ```

## Remediation

- **macOS missing plist:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so `setup_stats_wrapper` reinstalls `com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist`.
- **Linux missing or inactive systemd timer:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so the Linux scheduler setup reinstalls and enables `aidevops-stats-wrapper.timer` and `aidevops-stats-wrapper.service` under `~/.config/systemd/user`.
- **`set -euo pipefail` fail:** the post-t2418 wrapper emits `HEALTH-DASHBOARD-FAIL exit=<N>` on error. Grep `stats.log` on that prefix.
- **Body size / API error:** inspect `stats.log` — look at `gh` HTTP errors and `_update_health_issue_for_repo` failures.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified and documented on this issue.
- [ ] `gh issue view 2 --repo nezumitora/coin-shows-near-me` shows an update within 24h of closing this alert.
- [ ] `last_refresh:` marker is present in the dashboard body.
